name: Loan Data 136
definition: Specifies the loan data details in case of a buy sell back transaction.

UniqueTradeIdentifier.name: Unique Trade Identifier
UniqueTradeIdentifier.definition: Unique trade Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

EventDate.name: Event Date
EventDate.definition: Date on which the reportable event pertaining to the transaction and captured by the report took place.

ExecutionDateTime.name: Execution Date Time
ExecutionDateTime.definition: Indicates the date and time when the contract was executed.

ClearingStatus.name: Clearing Status
ClearingStatus.definition: Indicates whether clearing of contract has taken place.

TradingVenue.name: Trading Venue
TradingVenue.definition: Identification of the trading venue where the transaction was executed.

MasterAgreement.name: Master Agreement
MasterAgreement.definition: Reference to master agreement under which the counterparties concluded a documented transaction.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the opening leg (spot leg) of the secured financing transaction. In the case of rollover of open term transactions, this is the date on which the rollover settles, even if no exchange of cash takes place.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the closing leg (forward leg) of the transaction.

GeneralCollateral.name: General Collateral
GeneralCollateral.definition: Indication whether the transaction is subject to a general collateral arrangement.

PrincipalAmount.name: Principal Amount
PrincipalAmount.definition: Amount of money to be settled as of the start date and maturity date of the transaction.

UnitPrice.name: Unit Price
UnitPrice.definition: Price of unit of collateral component, including accrued interest for interest-bearing securities.

TerminationDate.name: Termination Date
TerminationDate.definition: Termination date in the case of a full early termination of the Securities Financing Transaction (SFT).
